# Warlock AI Live

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-live`

> Live & generative rich-media for @warlock.js/ai — ai.realtime() duplex voice sessions and ai.video() text-to-video. The heavy, demand-gated modalities, kept out of core so text/image/speech stay dependency-light.

## Skills

- [ai-live](@warlock.js/ai-live/skills/SKILL.md): Video generation and realtime voice sessions for Warlock AI. Importing this package mounts `ai.video` and `ai.realtime`; exports `video`, `realtime`, `VideoModelContract`, `RealtimeTransport`, `MockVideoModel` and `MockRealtimeTransport`. Use for "generate a video", "duplex voice", audio events or per-second costs. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for chat, still images, speech and one-shot transcription.
